- tests/test_validate_workflow_validate_bootstrap.py:310-505 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `test_renderer_isolated_imports_ignore_workspace_shadows_and_reject_external_origins` is defined but is not called from `main()`, so it never executes in CI.
  WHY: This test is the only one exercising runtime import isolation; severity disagreement: deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro rates it BLOCKER, while the other reviewers rate it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:764-782; scripts/validate_process.sh:2069-2087 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The dependency origin-verification Python script is duplicated between the workflow step and the shell function, allowing the copies to drift.
  WHY: If the copies diverge, the workflow preflight can pass while the shell function rejects dependencies at renderer invocation time, producing a misleading harness-error failure.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2053-2054 | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When `RUNTIME_DIR` is unset, the variable defaults produce `renderer_python=/renderer-venv/bin/python`, so a direct reference can fail with `command not found` instead of the intended clean `return 14`.
  WHY: The existing guard catches this only when `run_template_validation_harness_renderer` executes; future direct references could produce a noisy runtime error.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2096-2104 | confidence=[1]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The renderer invocation captures successful stdout in `renderer_summary` but does not log it.
  WHY: Renderer warnings, such as warnings about deprecated fields, will not appear in workflow logs.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:749-785 | confidence=[1]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The renderer dependency step creates a venv and reruns `pip install` on every run, including when a venv already exists.
  WHY: This adds 3-8 seconds of venv creation and dependency resolution per job.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:759 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The isolation relies on `RUNTIME_DIR` being unique per run, but that boundary is not explicitly validated.
  WHY: If `RUNTIME_DIR` is shared, concurrent jobs could race on the venv or allow shadow leakage.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- HARDENING_SUGGESTION
  File: scripts/validate_process.sh and .github/workflows/validate.yml

  Issue: The Python script used to verify dependency origins is duplicated byte-for-byte in the workflow YAML step and the shell function. A future change to dependency requirements that updates only one copy will lead to a non-obvious harness-error failure where the workflow step passes but the renderer invocation fails.
  Suggested minimal fix: Extract the inline Python verification script into a shared standalone script under scripts/ and source or invoke it from both locations.

  Location: 752, 759-760
  Issue: The isolation depends on ${RUNTIME_DIR} being an unshared, per-run directory, but this assumption is not explicitly validated.
  Suggested minimal fix: Add an explicit assertion that ${RUNTIME_DIR} is local to the runner and not a shared network or temporary mount point that could be accessed by concurrent jobs.
  Estimated lines changed: ~5
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2053-2054 (`local renderer_python="${RUNTIME_DIR:-}/renderer-venv/bin/python"`, `local renderer_empty_dir="${RUNTIME_DIR:-}/renderer-empty"`) | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: `RUNTIME_DIR:-` resolves to an empty string when `RUNTIME_DIR` is unset, producing `renderer_python=/renderer-venv/bin/python` (root-anchored path).
  WHY: Callers that source this file but never reach `run_template_validation_harness_renderer` skip the guard entirely; future code that references `renderer_python` directly will dereference `/renderer-venv/bin/python`, which is not an isolation failure but a `command not found` on most runners.
- tests/test_validate_workflow_validate_bootstrap.py:310 (test definition), 490-505 (main()) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: `test_renderer_isolated_imports_ignore_workspace_shadows_and_reject_external_origins` is defined but not invoked from `main()`.
  WHY: Without it running, a regression that reintroduces the import-shadowing vulnerability would pass CI text-pattern contract tests.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2096-2104 (renderer invocation block) | confidence=[1]
  PROBLEM: When `renderer_summary` is captured into a variable via `$(cd ... && "${renderer_python}" -I ... 2>&1)` and the `if !` test fails, the error output is appended to `GENERATE_LOG_FILE` only via `printf '%s\n' "${renderer_summary}"`.
  WHY: When the test passes, the success path silently drops the captured stdout, which can be useful diagnostic output (e.g. template renderer warnings about deprecated fields).
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:749-785 (renderer_dependencies step) | confidence=[1]
  PROBLEM: The step body now creates a venv under `${RUNTIME_DIR}/renderer-venv` on every run, even when the venv already exists from a previous validate run on the same runner.
  WHY: Each run re-runs `pip install` with `--isolated`, adding 3-8 seconds of venv creation and dependency resolution per job.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
